excerpts.content:
Can EL clients increase the BAL retention window?
<@&1460290804898861117> 

All accept geth prune BALs. The ask would be to increase it to 14299 epochs (from 3533), to match the CL payload retention window.
cc <@586161934425128960> <@845691100072509460> <@796570016966770688>
